'''Zygerria Four''' was a [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Zygerria system/Legends|Zygerria system]].

==History==
It was the home of many [[Slavery/Legends|slave traders]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and underwent [[Bombardment of Zygerria Four|orbital bombardment]] with the purpose of driving the slavers off of Zygerria Four. Once the local and violent [[Slaver/Legends|enslavers]] left their fortresses, [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]] have searched the fortresses for valuable objects that were left behind.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Scavenging|In the Wake}}</ref>

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1stm}}
